notes.title: [Patch Note] OVERTURN Boss Balancing (edited)
notes.content:
Hi all,  
Some of you might notice that we had an issue on the latest update yesterday (game freeze). We've fixed the game and now you can play the game without encountering this issue anymore.

You can check the update note of the new build below!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hi everyone,

We hope all is doing well! :)

We want to let you know that there is a new update today to balance the boss in the final stage. This will help all of you who has difficulties while fighting Melchior! :)

Also, for you who are waiting for the multiplayer, we are now doing our best to finish the multiplayer development. We want to give the best quality and experience to all of you, so please wait a little longer! We will update you as soon as the multiplayer is ready!

Thank you!

notes.title: [Patch Note] OVERTURN Update v1.0.7
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Hope you had a great weekend! ^^

Today we have a new update, various bugs have been fixed and Normal Difficulty has been rebalanced one more time. Update the game and enjoy OVERTURN! :)

Update:
- Fixed bugs on Stage 5.
- Fixed bugs that appeared during Melchior Boss fight.
- Re-balanced Normal Difficulty.

Thank you and happy Monday!

notes.title: [Patch Note] OVERTURN Update v1.0.6
notes.content:
Greetings!

Today we are having another update. We noticed that some of you had difficulties using the grip button when playing the game. An option for grip button has been applied to this update and various bugs have been fixed as well. Check the update below!

Update:
- Grip option has been added (Default/Toggle).
- Items that are no longer needed after being used will disappear.
- Fixed bugs that appeared in Stage 11.
- Lessen the difficulty of Stage 2 and 7.
- Re-balanced Normal Difficulty.

We will keep improving the game based on your suggestions however, all approved suggestions cannot be applied at once and we hope you understand. 

Whenever you have feedback/suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know! Any feedback are welcomed :)

notes.title: [Patch Note] OVERTURN Update v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are having another update today! We found out that sometimes laser gun failed to deal damage to enemies. Our developer has fixed the issue and now you can use laser guns without worries ;)

Update:
- Fixed a bug where players could not deal damages to enemies using laser gun in stage 2.

Happy gaming! :)

notes.title: [Patch Note] OVERTURN Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

According to your feedback, we have fixed several bugs and made some improvement to the game!  Please check the update below:

- Fixed a bug where the boss sometimes hides in the elevator in Stage 4
- Fixed a bug where some objects disappear in Stage 2
- Fixed a bug that caused when you continue from the middle of Stage 3
- Re-balance stage 5, 9 (Easy difficulty).


Thank you for your support on our game!ːsteamhappyː



YJMGAMES
